description:
Rediscover the joy of simple, safe, and comfortable riding with this folding electric trike, designed especially for seniors and riders with mobility or balance challenges. The low step-through frame lets you mount and dismount gracefully—no lifting your leg high, no fear of tipping, and no awkward maneuvers. It’s independence made easy.

The 2.125-inch semi-slick tires glide smoothly across city streets, absorbing bumps and cracks so your body doesn’t have to. Each ride feels steady, cushioned, and stable—keeping you comfortable from start to finish.

Need to bring along your essentials? The rear folding basket has space for everything from groceries to beach towels—and yes, even a small pet can ride along safely. Simply add a blanket for comfort and enjoy the journey with your favorite companion.

Designed for Seniors and Accessible Comfort

Low Step-Through Frame: Effortless mounting and dismounting minimizes fall risk and supports riders with limited mobility or flexibility.

Ergonomic Riding Position: Keeps shoulders, wrists, hips, and knees naturally aligned for a pain-free, relaxed ride. You’ll step off feeling refreshed, not sore.

Upright Frame Geometry: Promotes visibility, posture support, and confidence on every ride.

Powerful, Smooth Electric Assist

750W Motor: Choose between pedal-assist or full electric mode for adaptive control. Reach up to 15 mph fully electric or 28 mph with pedal assist.

High-Capacity Battery: Travel 18–40 miles in full-electric mode or 20–60 miles with pedal assist—perfect for errands, exercise, or exploring.

Front and Rear Disc Brakes: Mechanical disc brakes provide consistent, reliable stopping power for enhanced safety.

Built for Everyday Freedom

16-inch Wheels with 2.125″ Tires: Offer excellent traction and shock absorption for smooth, stable rides.

Adjustable Fit: Comfortably accommodates riders from 4′10″ to 6′5″, making it perfect for a wide range of users.

Rear Folding Basket Included: Spacious, sturdy, and practical for shopping, mobility gear, or personal items.

UL 2849 & UL 2271 Compliant as tested by ACT Labs—meeting top safety standards for electric systems and batteries.

This folding e-trike gives seniors and mobility-conscious riders the freedom to move safely, comfortably, and confidently. Whether commuting, running errands, or simply enjoying the outdoors, every glide feels empowering—and every ride ends with a smile.
